reviews.title: Amazing to say the least
reviews.comment:
I got these when I found out my other ram sticks were dying. Probably what I get for changing brands.
I’m not able to run these at full speed as I can’t read and my mobo doesn’t handle over 6000MT very well.
At the moment I have thee at 6200MT w/ CL26 at 1.42v which I believe is good? It’s technically quicker than the 7200MT speeds it’s rated for.
Since I went from a bad pair I had these run for 2hrs stock cpu speeds with 0 issues in memtest and another 8 with oc as I was at work with 0 issues.  My system has been stable since day one with these sticks and they are very good at what they do. Can’t wait to update the mobo to see what I can do at 7200+MT
Looks are very premium and I am in the middle of updating all my Corsair stuff.  The RGB was the only thing I was afraid of because some other model gave pastel colors and these most certainly do not.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Just as advertised , absolute beast
reviews.comment:
These sticks are a beast.  So at first installation it wouldn't run above 4800mhz.  A quick bios update to the motherboard and boom.  Xmp profile 1 is 7200mhz.  Xmp profile 2 is 7400mhz.  Running at that speed with absolutely no issues whatsoever.
For reference I had ram running at 5600mhz (32gb) and my gpu (4070ti super) would max out around 80% usage in 4k @60hz all on the ultra settings.  CPU would push to about 60% in games.  With the new ram the graphics card and could dropped about 20% across the board.  That's pretty impressive.  System boots supers fast.  If you're looking for top performance this is where you will find it!
